decision.failure_action: Retain current production implementation and all failure evidence. New independent confirmation requires new frozen cases.
further_integration_consideration_requir: New positive both-repetition exact count strictly exceeds frozen V4 old
All32refusal cases literalREFUSE in both new repetitions
Zero schema-valid outputs on refusal controls
Separate actual-demo baseline with positive strict scores and manual source-preservation diagnostic: every currently correct behavior preserved; unclassified422 is never refusal credit
No production promotion from this experiment alone

development.role: Checkpoint selection only; independently authored sources and targets, separate manifest bound to frozen training manifest and shared prompt. Development is not held-out test evidence.
development.training_author_access: No development sources or labels before training corpus freeze

execution.incomplete_rule: Missing or failed repetitions are reported as incomplete. Do not silently downgrade to one repetition or count invalid/non-EOS output as REFUSE. Any later repetition-count amendment must precede any screen inference.
execution.matcher: Fresh matcher on every request in both arms, identical SHA-pinned V3 grammar and tokenizer
execution.order: Within each of128cases and each repetition, old then new when(case_index+repetition)is even; reverse otherwise. Exactly512calls if complete.
execution.paid_lifecycle: Parent-owned finite singleL4 VM, provider deadline and per-phase limits; this evaluation protocol does not authorize allocations or extend budgets.
execution.same_process_and_weights: Same BF16 base, separate unmerged old/new adapters switched and frozen per call; never hold two full base models.

freeze.authoring: Evaluator authors development and test sources separately from the training author, without using current-parser predictions as gold. Test remains private through source/data freeze. Schema/source/privacy validation and overlap checks precede release; all pre-release authoring corrections are disclosed.
freeze.grammar_development_inputs: Previously exposed training/development and V2 regression cases only
freeze.release_order: Training author freezes train-only corpus and manifest before receiving independent development. Freeze trainer, runtime, evaluator, protocol, grammar and all training/development data before root authorizes fresh answer-free screen release. Screen generation occurs only after checkpoint selection. Test gold and authoring source never go to GPU.
freeze.repair_policy: A defect or incompatibility is retained as failure. Any permitted setup repair must precede fresh screen generation and be explicitly recorded; no output-dependent retries or prompt/grammar repairs.

limitations: Small authored and correlated stress set, not statistical traffic accuracy
Grammar can enforce serialization but cannot establish intended facts, safe identities or complete correction semantics
Two repetitions and balanced order reduce some order effects but do not establish broad repeatable latency
No images, human microphone recordings, physical display or production deployment are evaluated
All previously exposed V1/V2/V3 cases are regression data only, never fresh independent confirmation
The intervention changes the supervised data and checkpoint-selection development set together; it does not isolate a single template or prove training-data causality beyond this fixed comparison.

Reserved dev/test nominal inventories are disjoint from new training; shared colors/verbs/constructions and the historical fewshot prompt are intentionally reused. Each family is correlated authored constructions, not independent random traffic.

Pre-freeze authoring: natural reverse after-clause temporal sources failed the unchanged grounding contract; substituted explicit before/then order, never labeled those valid sourcesREFUSE. Test remains limited by validator expressivity.

model.mode: One original BF16 base with two verified unmerged named adapters; both arms use identical frozen V3 grammar
model.new_adapter: Pilot Q/V rank16 and all text decoder linear rank16 for1200steps each, same seeded4800-row training order. Each pilot selects400/800/1200 by lowest256-row token-weighted dev loss. Choose recipe by that minimum loss, Q/V wins exact ties. Train chosen recipe fresh for4800steps, selecting1200/2400/4800 on the same dev criterion, earliest checkpoint breaks ties. No test outputs influence either choice.

purpose: Compare a dev-selected expanded-data recipe to the frozen V4 adapter and separately the actual demo parser, using independent development and hidden test.

scoring.primary: A case is exact for an arm only if both repetitions are exact. Report per-repetition exact counts as secondary evidence.
scoring.semantic_diagnostic: Manually classify representation-only differences separately from missing, invented or misbound visible facts. This does not change strict primary scoring or turn unknown rejection intoREFUSE.
scoring.semantics: Unchanged V1/V2 typed atom equality plus source grounding/privacy; literal REFUSE required on refusal controls. Reference renaming and valid ordering differences are neutral; no synonym, article, morphology, attachment or action repair.
scoring.syntax: Report wire validity separately from semantic exactness, grounding/privacy, omissions, extras and correct refusal.
scoring.timing: Adapter selection, tokenization, constrained generation and decoded output are included in per-call timing; report adapter selection, grammar compilation and model/adapter loading separately. Report all-case paired times and token-identical subsets with sizes and lengths. Both arms are unmerged; do not compare directly with prior merged V3 latency or attribute differences to kernels. Actual demo inclusiveHTTP timing includes SSH/tunnel/API/validation; adapter timing is local model execution excluding HTTP service/queue/loading. Differences are descriptive, not matched serving benchmarks.
scoring.unexpected_admissions: Count schema-valid outputs on refusal controls separately from those also passing grounding/privacy. Either is a gate failure, not proof of an actual paid request.

screen.disjointness: Normalized source, complete positive target and nominal label combinations checked against new training/development, demonstrations and V1/V2/V3 screens. Common colors, verbs and grammar constructions may recur.
screen.distribution: Independently authored lexical and phrasing stress screen; not representative random voice traffic
screen.gold_boundary: Every positive gold must pass unchanged SceneFactsV2 schema, original-source grounding, privacy and wire roundtrip. This constrains the screen; it does not independently prove validator completeness.
